# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

 

 

## Where we’re making news

What are others saying about our impact? With operations in 70 countries, Cargill and our customers
are making news around the globe. Here are some of the latest stories.

[More News][62]

Our large customer base includes every industry from industrial and data centres to farms, marine,
construction and much more. Our vast, diverse fleet of [HVO-fuelled vehicles][82] and national depot
network enables us to provide 24-48 hour deliveries as standard, plus an urgent emergency delivery
service for time-sensitive scenarios. You can count on us when you need us most.

any of our other products and fuel-related services – you can rest easy, safe in the knowledge of
our team and in-house experts.

## Our environmental commitment

Crown Oil was the first UK fuel supplier to switch our entire delivery fleet to HVO fuel, and we are
the first to be [certified carbon neutral by BSI to ISO 14068-1][83] and certified to be net zero by
2050 with their Net Zero Pathway. We are now supporting businesses in their journey to net zero too,
with our range of sustainable solutions on hand.

With over 75 years’ experience in the industry, we are committed to providing the best solution to
support your business. That’s why we’ve extended our product portfolio to include a range of
cleaner-burning products to support you in reaching your sustainability goals.

## Access to any site

drivers to access restricted or rural sites.

# Fuels & Lubricants Supplier Since 1947

As a UK leading fuels and lubricants supplier, we believe excellent service before and after your
oil delivery is the key to our success. This, combined with our expert, local knowledge, competitive
fuel prices and reliable deliveries, ensures we’ve remained at the forefront of the oil industry for
over 75 years.

## Fuelling your success since 1947

Our large customer base includes every industry from industrial and data centres to farms, marine,
construction and much more. Our vast, diverse fleet of [HVO-fuelled vehicles][82] and national depot
network enables us to provide 24-48 hour deliveries as standard, plus an urgent emergency delivery
service for time-sensitive scenarios. You can count on us when you need us most.

Whether you’re looking for diesel or heating oils, renewable fuels, lubricants, storage tanks, or
any of our other products and fuel-related services – you can rest easy, safe in the knowledge of
our team and in-house experts.

## Our environmental commitment

Crown Oil was the first UK fuel supplier to switch our entire delivery fleet to HVO fuel, and we are
the first to be [certified carbon neutral by BSI to ISO 14068-1][83] and certified to be net zero by
2050 with their Net Zero Pathway. We are now supporting businesses in their journey to net zero too,
with our range of sustainable solutions on hand.

With over 75 years’ experience in the industry, we are committed to providing the best solution to
support your business. That’s why we’ve extended our product portfolio to include a range of
cleaner-burning products to support you in reaching your sustainability goals.

## First Class Service Every Time

## Access to any site

140+ tankers of all sizes, with flexible delivery windows to suit your operation and experienced
drivers to access restricted or rural sites.

[Find out more][84]

## 24/7 national delivery

Fast 24-48 hour delivery as standard, with emergency supply available round-the-clock, 365 days a
year.

[Find out more][85]

## All services, one supplier

Complete fuel, lubrication and environmental services from one supplier, under one roof, with one
dedicated account manager.

[Find out more][86]

## Low-carbon fuel solutions

A certified carbon-neutral supplier and trusted HVO partner, helping organisations meet
sustainability and ESG commitments.

[Find out more][87]

# We are Neste

We are the world’s leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) which
enable our customers reduce their greenhouse gas emissions. We also produce high-quality oil
products.

[

### Renewable diesel

Neste MY Renewable Diesel™ helps businesses and consumers reduce their greenhouse gas emissions by
replacing fossil diesel with renewable diesel.


][11][

### Sustainable aviation fuel (SAF)

Neste MY Sustainable Aviation Fuel™ (SAF) enables the aviation industry to reduce the greenhouse gas
emissions of air travel and transportation by replacing fossil jet fuel.


][12][

### Marine fuels

For the marine transport sector, we offer solutions that help shipping companies, including cargo
owners and charterers, to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions.


][13][

### Oil products

We offer high-quality oil products for road transport, heavy machinery, agriculture, aviation and
marine sectors as well as for oil and petrochemical industries.


][14]

replacing virgin fossil-based plastics with renewable alternatives, proving that high-quality
consumer electronics can have a lower carbon footprint.

Learn more

# We are Neste

We are the world’s leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) which
enable our customers reduce their greenhouse gas emissions. We also produce high-quality oil
products.

[

### Renewable diesel

Neste MY Renewable Diesel™ helps businesses and consumers reduce their greenhouse gas emissions by
replacing fossil diesel with renewable diesel.


][11][

### Sustainable aviation fuel (SAF)

Neste MY Sustainable Aviation Fuel™ (SAF) enables the aviation industry to reduce the greenhouse gas
emissions of air travel and transportation by replacing fossil jet fuel.


][12][

### Marine fuels

For the marine transport sector, we offer solutions that help shipping companies, including cargo
owners and charterers, to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions.


][13][

### Oil products

We offer high-quality oil products for road transport, heavy machinery, agriculture, aviation and
marine sectors as well as for oil and petrochemical industries.


][14]
[

### Sony unveils new earbuds and TVs powered by renewable Neste RE™

Partnering with Neste, Mitsubishi Corporation and 11 other global companies, Sony is partly
replacing virgin fossil-based plastics with renewable alternatives, proving that high-quality
consumer electronics can have a lower carbon footprint.

Read more

][15][

### Neste delivers all-time high quarterly results in exceptional market environment — long-term
### fundamentals for renewables strengthening

A conference call in English for investors and analysts was held on 24 July 2026.

Read more

][16][

### Let’s fuel change

Whether you are a company making the switch from fossil to renewable fuels, a consumer choosing
lower-climate impact solutions, or a policymaker advancing targets—we all have a role. See how we
can contribute to the energy transition together already today.

Learn more

][17][

### Strengthening collaboration with DHL

DHL and Neste are partnering to decarbonize logistics, with renewable fuels playing a crucial role
in DHL's plan to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050.

Read more

][18]

## Releases and news

Here you will find our latest press and stock exchange releases, and news.

[See all][19]
[

### About Neste

Neste has a long history of developing innovative, more sustainable solutions for road transport and
aviation. Our transformation journey has a strong Nordic heritage and it has taken us from being a
local oil refiner to becoming a global leader in renewable and circular solutions.

Read more

][20]
[

### Innovation as a driver for performance

Innovation, technology and R&D are essential across our operations, supporting raw material, product
and technology development, as well as quality assurance and performance for all our solutions
(renewable, circular and fossil).

Read more

][21]
[

### Sustainability in Neste’s everyday business

Our sustainability approach includes ambitions related to climate, biodiversity, human rights, as
well as supply chain and raw materials. Together with our partners we work toward reaching our
targets across the value chain.

Read more

## [Supporting Sustainability For 30 Years and Growing][8]

We launched on Maui in 1995 with America’s first retail biodiesel pump and remain the
longest-operating biodiesel company in the USA.

[Learn More][9]

## [A Future Vision As Clear As Our Biodiesel][10]

Our community-based biodiesel model supports Hawaiʻi’s mandate for 100% renewable electricity
production by 2045.

[Learn More][11]

## [Recycling Used Cooking Oil Statewide][12]

Collected free of charge, each gallon of used cooking oil we recycle produces nearly one gallon of
biodiesel at our refinery on Hawaiʻi Island.

[Learn More][13]

## [Respectfully Rooted In Hawaiʻi's Resiliency][14]

We farm sunflowers and other crops on Maui and Kaua‘i with a passion for regenerative agriculture
that supports energy security and food security.

[Learn More][15]

## [Trusted Trailblazers In Our Industry][16]

As biodiesel industry pioneers, our leaders are sought-after speakers to share the benefits of
biodiesel on the local, national and global stage.

[Learn More][17]

Founded on Maui in 1995, Pacific Biodiesel® is the longest operating biodiesel producer in the USA
and has been the sole commercial producer of liquid biofuels in Hawaiʻi for nearly three decades.
The company recycles used cooking oil from restaurants statewide to produce 6 million gallons of
distilled biodiesel each year at its refinery on Hawaiʻi Island; this 100% renewable fuel is sold
entirely in the state.

**OUR MISSION:** To promote a clean, sustainable energy future through the community-based
production of renewable fuels.

## Our Vision For A More Sustainable Hawai‘i

We have a realistic pathway to support Hawai‘i’s mandate for 100% renewable electricity production
by 2045. Our goal is to reach this by 2040.

With a model of regenerative agriculture and renewable energy, we are helping to fight climate
change, support energy security, bolster food security and grow [Hawaiʻi’s circular economy][18].

By 2030: Our Hawaiʻi Island [refinery][19] is using 100% local feedstock for its current 6 million
gallons per year (6 MGY) production of biodiesel.

By 2033: We have the capacity to locally produce 16 MGY of [biodiesel][20] for Hawaiʻi.

By 2040: Our two in-state refineries are producing biodiesel from 100% Hawai‘i-sourced feedstock,
and processing virgin oil from [agricultural operations][21] on 75,000 acres statewide.

Our [community-based production][22] model also includes culinary oils, meal for animal feed, and
co-products from biodiesel production such as glycerin and potassium sulfate, a fertilizer for local
agriculture.

[Kākou][23] is our culture. It takes all of us, working together, to achieve our vision. We value
collaboration and teamwork with an Aloha spirit.

## Recycling Used Cooking Oil In Hawaiʻi

Pacific Biodiesel offers free used cooking oil pick-up service for all food establishments on O‘ahu,
Maui County and Hawai‘i Island wishing to recycle their waste oil and reduce their carbon footprint.
We have experienced and dependable technicians for grease trap pumping and other related services.

#### Used Cooking Oil Collection
* FREE Pick-Up Service
* Customizable Containment Solutions
* Reliable & Convenient Service

#### Grease Trap Pumping
* Grease Trap Monitoring
* Regularly Scheduled Pumping Service
* Emergency Pumping, available 24/7
* Proper disposal of all grease trap waste
* Fully permitted and licensed by State and County governments
* Equipment dedicated for food service
* Core sampling to measure the percentage of fats, oils and grease (FOG) to ensure you stay in
  compliance with local guidelines and avoid costly fines

#### Drain Cleaning Services (Available On Oʻahu Only)
* Hydro jetting - 3000 psi high pressure washing of your plumbing lines to help prevent backups
* Drain snaking - an effective way to dislodge clogs in your lines
* Preventative Maintenance
* Emergency Service, available 24/7

[Learn More][24]

## Supporting Hawaiʻi’s Circular Economy

See how our carbon negative, zero-waste biodiesel model keeps the sustainable cycle going.

[Learn More][25]

## Our Customers

We are grateful to have customers across all islands and industries in Hawai‘i, who make the choice
to utilize our premium biodiesel as part of their business operations.

can be used in any of our existing generating units, and it can be stored in large tanks to give us
that long duration storage that we need that batteries and current storage technology can’t provide.
We need a fuel like biodiesel to get us through those periods where we have lots of clouds or rainy
weather here on Kauaʻi and we’re not getting the output from our solar farms. KIUC is very pleased
to partner with Pacif

## City & County of Honolulu

For more than 15 years, the City & County of Honolulu has used locally produced biodiesel in its
fleet of vehicles, including nearly 1,000 pickup trucks, dump trucks, ambulances and garbage trucks.

“Changing our fuel source from ULSD to B20 was not a difficult decision considering the benefits of
reduced emissions (PM, smoke and odor), local production and lower State and County (Oahu) taxes. No
special dispensing equipment or modifications were necessary, and we have used B20 interchangeably
with straight ULSD without issues. Use of B20 has increased our awareness about the importance of
having clean and properly maintained fuel storage and dispensing systems.”

*– Robert Primiano, Division Chief– Automotive Equipment Service, City and County of Honolulu*

“Fair Wind Cruises has been using biodiesel since 2013. We converted all our vessels and company
trucks to use locally produced biodiesel from Pacific Biodiesel, reducing our dependence on

ocean, it is better for our vessels and reduces our maintenance costs.”

performance. And, believe me, I would hear if they had any issues.”

*– Lynn Rindlisbacher, owner of Maui-based Magic Island Construction*

production of renewable fuels.

## Our Vision For A More Sustainable Hawai‘i

We have a realistic pathway to support Hawai‘i’s mandate for 100% renewable electricity production
by 2045. Our goal is to reach this by 2040.

change, support energy security, bolster food security and grow [Hawaiʻi’s circular economy][18].

gallons per year (6 MGY) production of biodiesel.

and processing virgin oil from [agricultural operations][21] on 75,000 acres statewide.

Our [community-based production][22] model also includes culinary oils, meal for animal feed, and
co-products from biodiesel production such as glycerin and potassium sulfate, a fertilizer for local
agriculture.

[Kākou][23] is our culture. It takes all of us, working together, to achieve our vision. We value
collaboration and teamwork with an Aloha spirit.

* Hydro jetting - 3000 psi high pressure washing of your plumbing lines to help prevent backups
* Drain snaking - an effective way to dislodge clogs in your lines
* Preventative Maintenance
* Emergency Service, available 24/7

# Build the future with advanced biofuels today.

Developing today’s lowest carbon fuels.
Be a part of climate change solutions now.

[Learn More About Aemetis][9]

## Proven Technology

Our technology and facilities efficiently produce the renewable fuels needed to transition away from
petroleum.

[Company Presentation][10]

## Advanced Biofuels

Our integrated approach cleans the air, displaces fossil fuel energy, and helps farmers thrive.

[What We Create][11]

## Smart Investment

Renewable fuels are both environmentally sustainable and, with our dynamic suite of solutions, a
financially sound investment. Aemetis is traded on the Nasdaq under AMTX.

[Investing In Aemetis][12]

#### Low Carbon
#### Ethanol

#### Renewable
#### Natural Gas

#### Carbon Capture and Sequestration

[Our Products][17]

**Eric McAfee** – Founder/Chairman/CEO of Aemetis, Inc.

## For SAF’s Take-off, look to India’s policies

“The India government has now mandated that the three large companies that own 70% of the oil
refineries in India must purchase biodiesel on a “Cost Plus“ basis… The airline industry should do
the same in order to rapidly grow the production of sustainable aviation fuel in order to
decarbonize aviation… The actual problem we have is that we are not serious about the adoption of
renewable fuels. That is a political problem, not an industry problem.”

[Read Article][18]

## On June 10th 2022, Aemetis hosted a Ribbon Cutting Ceremony for the Aemetis Biogas Central Dairy
## Digester Project at our Keyes Advanced Fuels Facility.

[See the Event Page][19]

**Valerie Sarisky-Reed**, Director, Bioenergy Technologies Office – U.S. Department of Energy

## Ethanol vs. Petroleum-Based Fuel Carbon Emissions

“Biofuels have been proven to emit significantly lower greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions than
petroleum-based fuels, and recent scientific studies indicate that net-zero emission biofuels are
not only possible, but achievable.”

[Read Article][20]
[rfa logo]

“The India government has now mandated that the three large companies that own 70% of the oil
refineries in India must purchase biodiesel on a “Cost Plus“ basis… The airline industry should do
the same in order to rapidly grow the production of sustainable aviation fuel in order to
decarbonize aviation… The actual problem we have is that we are not serious about the adoption of
renewable fuels. That is a political problem, not an industry problem.”

### [Agri-Pulse Open Mic: Geoff Cooper - Renewable Fuels Association][123]

This week's Open Mic guest is Geoff Cooper, President and CEO of the Renewable Fuels Association.
Leaders of the group recently spent a week in Washington lobbying for Senate approval of voluntary
E15 legislation. Cooper cites recent studies suggesting strong support for sales of higher ethanol
blends among voters from both political parties. He also discusses opportunity for industry growth
in the maritime, airline and related liquid transportation fuels arena. Cooper says RFA supports
efforts by the Trump administration to balance trade with Brazil.

This week's Open Mic guest is Geoff Cooper, President and CEO of the Renewable Fuels Association.

blends among voters from both political parties. He also discusses opportunity for industry growth
in the maritime, airline and related liquid transportation fuels arena. Cooper says RFA supports
efforts by the Trump administration to balance trade with Brazil.

## Welcome to Biomedical Journal

Biomedical Journal of Scientific & Technical Research (BJSTR - [www.biomedres.us][71]) is a
multidisciplinary, scholarly [Open Access publisher][72] focused on Genetic, Biomedical and Remedial
missions in relation with Technical Knowledge as well. We crave to select ground-breaking research
based on modernism, aptness, scientific connotation, prospective spectator interests, etc. We
endeavor to provide by far and liberally accessible belvedere to researchers and practitioners in
support of their novel and valuable ideas. We already have 2000+ [Editorial Board][73] members along
with 5000+ [Published articles][74] in our box. Our BJSTR maintains a scrupulous, methodical, fair
[peer review process][75]. Besides, quality control is riveted in each step of the publication
process.

#### Aim & Scope

We aim to frame tremendous standard international academic journals and strive to provide a
congenial and candidly attainable podium for researchers all over the world to present their
research victories and to reciprocate their ideas.

[  Read More ][76]

#### What do we do?

The BJSTR is an open access medical and clinical research publication that gives acclaimed
scientific authors and research experts a global platform to share their work among like-minded
peers and help accumulate scientific knowledge in a singular repository.

[  Read More ][77]

#### Why publish with us?

Our production process follows a high standard to ensure quality publications. All manuscripts are
endured to high level terminology compilation and bursting amendments, as well as being processed
through QC progressions, to ensure trustworthiness.

## **The Power** of one Integrated Workflow

## We may already have the answers to your question.

What is job scheduling software?

Job scheduling software is a tool designed to streamline the process of planning and managing tasks
and appointments. It allows businesses to allocate resources efficiently.

How does job scheduling software improve efficiency?

It optimizes routes, matches skills to jobs, reduces travel time, and provides real-time visibility.

What features should I look for in job scheduling software?

Look for drag-and-drop calendars, skill filtering, route optimization, mobile access, and real-time
updates.

Can job scheduling software integrate with other tools?

 Yes, Commusoft integrates with accounting, payments, and communication tools for a seamless
workflow.

## We may already have the answers to your question.

What is job scheduling software?

Job scheduling software is a tool designed to streamline the process of planning and managing tasks
and appointments. It allows businesses to allocate resources efficiently.

How does job scheduling software improve efficiency?

It optimizes routes, matches skills to jobs, reduces travel time, and provides real-time visibility.

What features should I look for in job scheduling software?

Look for drag-and-drop calendars, skill filtering, route optimization, mobile access, and real-time
updates.

Can job scheduling software integrate with other tools?

 Yes, Commusoft integrates with accounting, payments, and communication tools for a seamless
workflow.

# Pectin Methylesterase (PME) Pectin Methylesterase (PME) (EC 3.1.1.11) — Industrial Pectin
# De-esterification

High-activity PME for precise pectin de-esterification in fruit and vegetable processing. Maintains
viscosity, gel strength, texture, and clarification by modifying pectin charge and calcium binding.
Operates optimally at pH 3.5–5.5 and 40°C–55°C. Available in clear amber liquid or light brown
powder with activities of 1,000 U/mL (liquid) and 5,000–10,000 U/g (powder). MOQ 1 L (liquid) / 1 kg
(powder). Ships worldwide.

## Applications

PME enables targeted pectin modification to control cloud, viscosity, texture, gel structure, and
clarification across beverage, sauce, and puree manufacturing.

1
🍊

### Citrus Juice Cloud Stability

De-esterifies pectin in orange and grapefruit juice to help control cloud stability—reducing
unwanted settling or excessive clarification.

[Learn more →][11]
2
🍅

### Tomato Paste & Ketchup

Promotes calcium-pectin gel formation to increase viscosity and consistency—helping reduce water
separation in thicker sauces like tomato paste and ketchup.

3
🥕

### Vegetable Firmness Retention

Applied in pre-treatment of sliced vegetables and fries; PME with calcium enhances firmness
retention during thermal processing.

4
🫙

### Jam & Jelly Gelling

Controlled pectin de-esterification supports reliable gel set in low-sugar jam and jelly recipes,
ensuring consistent structure during scale-up.

5
🍷

### Wine & Cider Clarification

De-methoxylates pectin in wine and cider must to support faster settling, improved filterability,
and clearer product appearance.

6
🧃

### Fruit Puree Processing

Modifies pectin structure in mango, apple, and banana purees to achieve controlled viscosity and
improved pumpability in processing lines.

### [ Kardea Brown ][128]

Kardea Brown is a contemporary Southern cook born in Charleston, South Carolina. She is host of Food
Network’s Delicious Miss Brown and has appeared on Beat Bobby Flay, Chopped Junior and more.

[ [Ree Drummond prepares Cauliflower Fried Rice, as seen on The Pioneer Woman, Season 20.] ][129]

### [ Ree Drummond ][130]

Ree is a writer, photographer, ranch wife and mother of four. She is now host of Food Network's hit
show The Pioneer Woman.
[ ][131]

### [ Ina Garten ][132]

Ina throws open the doors of her Hamptons home for delicious food, dazzling ideas and good fun on
Barefoot Contessa.

### [ Sunny Anderson ][134]

Food Network Chef

Sunny has been a Food Network staple for over 20 years, serving as a co-host on The Kitchen, a team
captain on BBQ Brawl and a judge countless cooking competition shows.

[ [Host Bobby Flay in final round, as seen on Bobby’s Triple Threat, Season 4.] ][135]

### [ Bobby Flay ][136]

Food Network Chef

Bobby Flay is an award-winning chef, restaurateur, cookbook author and media personality. He's an
Iron Chef, and host of Beat Bobby Flay, Bobby's Triple Threat and BBQ Brawl.

[ ][137]

### [ Jet Tila ][138]

Food Network Chef

Jet Tila is a chef, culinary anthropologist, entrepreneur, author and Food Network star. He is the
host of Ready Jet Cook and has appeared on dozens of Food Network shows.

[ ][139]

### [ Guy Fieri ][140]

Food Network Host

Guy Fieri is a chef, restaurateur and the host of 'Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives,' 'Guy's Grocery
Games' and more.

Girl Meets Farm Season 15] ][141]

Food Network Chef

Best-selling cookbook author Molly Yeh brings her charm, unique background and spin on comfort food
to her TV series.

[[Application introduction of Paints]][208]
[Introduction of applications: Paint][209]

In general, Paint refers to Powder coating paint, Emulsion paint or Solvent based paint (oil
vanish). 

[more][210]
[[Pearl luster Printing Ink]][211]
[Introduction of applications: Pearl luster Printing Ink][212]

Pearly luster printing ink is becoming popular. Pearly-luster printing ink uses a special
pearlescent pigment that is different from metal pigment and helps to save costs. This is why the
demand for pearly-luster printing ink is growing.

[more][213]
[[Special Effect Color Masterbatch]][214]
[Introduction Of Applications: Plastics][215]

You can find almost all of these special effect pigments used in the plastics industry at iSuoChem.
We'll list some of these effect pigments in the next article for your reference.

[more][216]
[[effect pigment for ceramics]][217]
[Special effect pigment for ceramics][218]

iSuoChem® effect pigment is widely used in ceramic glaze, enamel wares, glass and glassware
decorations. Pearl pigment and glitter powder can be used as overglaze color. Thermochromic pigment
is to be used in mug or ceramic wares and makes the color changing by temperature.

[more][219]
[[Pigments for Decoration]][220]
[Introduction of applications: Effect Pigments for Decoration][221]

Why decoration? It is human nature to pursue beauty, and it will never stop. Beauty makes people
have a more positive attitude towards life. When people have safe living space and enough food, they
probably want to decorate their rooms, beautify their appearance, decorate their working space and
social public environment. In short, people want to make life beautiful, so decoration becomes
necessary daily need.

[more][222]
[[Cosmetics Effect pigment]][223]
[Special effect pigment for cosmetics][224]

iSuoChem® cosmetic grade pearl pigment is strictly following International regulation on chemistry,
heavy metal and micro-biology. It is safe for human body and is able to enhance your beauty.

[more][225]
[[Pigment for Repair Paint]][226]
[Various Effect Pigment for Repair Paint][227]

iSuoChem can supply various effect pigment, Like Pearl pigment, Chameleon pigment, glitter powder,
Glow pigment and many other effect pigment to mix with paint as Car Repair paint.

[more][228]
[[Effect pigment for paper & card]][229]
[Introduction of applications: Paper & Cards][230]

When you need a complete solution for printing on paper & cards, feel free to contact iSuoChem's
team and you can get full support on the first time.

[more][231]
[[Pearl pigment for leather]][232]
[Introduction of applications: Pearlescent Leather][233]

Pearl leather has a softer look and more subtle sheen than normal leather. In comparison, our
Pearlessence leather has a specially formulated finish with a pearl pigment. This combination pearl
finish provides superior durability and increased water resistance.

[more][234]
[[Pigment for textile printing]][235]
[Introduction of applications: Textiles][236]

Textile printing technology is based on a variety of ink resins as the carrier, composed of effect
pigments or dyes and related additives, with good adhesion. By different printing methods, words and
drawings are printed on textile fabrics.

vanish). 

[more][210]
[[Pearl luster Printing Ink]][211]
[Introduction of applications: Pearl luster Printing Ink][212]

Pearly luster printing ink is becoming popular. Pearly-luster printing ink uses a special
pearlescent pigment that is different from metal pigment and helps to save costs. This is why the
demand for pearly-luster printing ink is growing.

[more][213]
[[Special Effect Color Masterbatch]][214]
[Introduction Of Applications: Plastics][215]

You can find almost all of these special effect pigments used in the plastics industry at iSuoChem.
We'll list some of these effect pigments in the next article for your reference.

[more][216]
[[effect pigment for ceramics]][217]
[Special effect pigment for ceramics][218]

iSuoChem® effect pigment is widely used in ceramic glaze, enamel wares, glass and glassware
decorations. Pearl pigment and glitter powder can be used as overglaze color. Thermochromic pigment
is to be used in mug or ceramic wares and makes the color changing by temperature.

[more][219]
[[Pigments for Decoration]][220]
[Introduction of applications: Effect Pigments for Decoration][221]

Why decoration? It is human nature to pursue beauty, and it will never stop. Beauty makes people
have a more positive attitude towards life. When people have safe living space and enough food, they
probably want to decorate their rooms, beautify their appearance, decorate their working space and
social public environment. In short, people want to make life beautiful, so decoration becomes
necessary daily need.

[more][222]
[[Cosmetics Effect pigment]][223]
[Special effect pigment for cosmetics][224]

iSuoChem® cosmetic grade pearl pigment is strictly following International regulation on chemistry,
heavy metal and micro-biology. It is safe for human body and is able to enhance your beauty.

[more][225]

[Various Effect Pigment for Repair Paint][227]

Glow pigment and many other effect pigment to mix with paint as Car Repair paint.

[more][228]

[Introduction of applications: Paper & Cards][230]

When you need a complete solution for printing on paper & cards, feel free to contact iSuoChem's
team and you can get full support on the first time.

[more][231]
[[Pearl pigment for leather]][232]
[Introduction of applications: Pearlescent Leather][233]

Pearl leather has a softer look and more subtle sheen than normal leather. In comparison, our
Pearlessence leather has a specially formulated finish with a pearl pigment. This combination pearl
finish provides superior durability and increased water resistance.

[more][234]

[Introduction of applications: Textiles][236]

Textile printing technology is based on a variety of ink resins as the carrier, composed of effect
pigments or dyes and related additives, with good adhesion. By different printing methods, words and
drawings are printed on textile fabrics.

fatty acids, surfactants, and emulsifiers. It also functions as a plasticizer and processing aid in
plastics and rubber production, and acts as a lubricant base oil in metalworking fluids.

and adhesion in inks, coatings, and paints. It is applied in animal feed as an energy and fatty acid

emulsifier, lubricant, and processing aid in plastics and rubber, and is used in metalworking as a
cutting fluid, lubricant, and metal cleaning agent. Additionally, it acts as an environmentally
friendly solvent, degreaser, and industrial cleaning agent, used in cosmetics and personal care

Bulk supply for cosmetics, pharma, food & industrial applications. Stable quality, global shipping.
Refined glycerin 99.7% versatile ingredient widely used across multiple industries. In daily
chemical and personal care, it acts as a humectant in cosmetics, skincare products, toothpaste, and
soaps. In food processing, it serves as a water retention agent, sweetener, emulsifier, and solvent.
It is also used as a humectant in tobacco processing, and as an excipient and lubricant in
pharmaceutical products. In industrial applications, it is a key raw material for alkyd resins,
polyurethane, coatings, and inks, as well as a softener and anti-wrinkle agent in textiles. It also
functions as a plasticizer and antifreeze agent in plastics and rubber. With consistent quality and
reliable performance, it meets the diverse technical requirements of cosmetic, food, pharmaceutical,
and manufacturing sectors. Contact us for detailed specifications and bulk pricing inquiries.

][49] [

## Crude Glycerin

Crude Glycerin is an industrial-grade raw material primarily used as the feedstock for producing
refined glycerin. It serves as a key component in manufacturing alkyd resins, paints, coatings, and
inks. It is also widely used in cement grinding aids, concrete admixtures, textile dyeing
auxiliaries, and humectants. In plastic and rubber processing, it functions as a plasticizer and
mold release agent. Additionally, it is used in feed additives, bio-fermentation, metalworking
fluids, antifreeze, and wastewater treatment. With consistent quality and reliable performance, it
meets the diverse technical requirements of chemical, construction, and manufacturing sectors.
Contact us for detailed specifications and bulk pricing inquiries.

][50] [

## Palm Acid Oil (PAO)

Palm Acid Oil is a versatile industrial-grade raw material widely used across multiple sectors. It
serves as a primary feedstock for producing biodiesel and fatty acid methyl esters (FAME). In soap
and detergent manufacturing, it is valued for its excellent detergency as a core ingredient for
fatty acids, surfactants, and emulsifiers. It also functions as a plasticizer and processing aid in
plastics and rubber production, and acts as a lubricant base oil in metalworking fluids.
Additionally, it serves as an industrial solvent, cleaning agent, and degreaser, improving wetting
and adhesion in inks, coatings, and paints. It is applied in animal feed as an energy and fatty acid
supplement, used as a softener and emulsifier in the textile industry, and functions as an
emulsifier and penetrant in agrochemical formulations. With consistent quality and reliable
performance, it meets the diverse technical requirements of chemical, energy, and agricultural
sectors. Contact us for detailed specifications and bulk pricing inquiries.

][51] [

## Palm Methyl Ester

Palm Methyl Ester is a high-performance industrial intermediate widely used across multiple sectors.
It serves as a key raw material for fatty alcohols, surfactants, and detergent additives. In
biodiesel production, it offers excellent stability and low-temperature fluidity. It functions as an
emulsifier, lubricant, and processing aid in plastics and rubber, and is used in metalworking as a
cutting fluid, lubricant, and metal cleaning agent. Additionally, it acts as an environmentally
friendly solvent, degreaser, and industrial cleaning agent, used in cosmetics and personal care
products as an emollient and emulsifier. It is applied in pesticides and agrochemicals as a solvent
and penetrant, and used in inks, coatings, and adhesives to improve wetting and leveling properties.
With consistent quality and reliable performance, it meets the diverse technical requirements of
chemical, energy, and personal care sectors. Contact us for detailed specifications and bulk pricing
inquiries.

][52] [

## Vegetable Wax

Vegetable Wax is a versatile natural wax widely used across multiple sectors. In food processing, it
serves as a glazing agent, fresh-keeping coating, and release agent. In cosmetics such as lipsticks,
balms, and lotions, it functions as an effective hardener, emollient, and thickener. It is also used
in candle making to improve burning performance, hardness, and gloss. Additionally, it is added to
inks and coatings to enhance scratch resistance, wear resistance, and weatherability, and used as a
lubricant and dispersant in plastic and rubber processing. It is applied in leather care, shoe
polishes, and furniture wax for polishing and waterproofing, used in pharmaceutical products as an
ointment base and coating material, and used in paper and cardboard as a water repellent and sizing
agent. It is also used in hot melt adhesives to improve hardness and thermal stability, used in
precision casting and mold making as a release agent, and applied in agricultural coatings for fruit
and vegetable preservation. With consistent quality and reliable performance, it meets the diverse
technical requirements of food, cosmetic, and industrial sectors. Contact us for detailed

KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer, which has integrated complexes located strategically in
Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, innovative and
sustainable products and solutions. We are the manufacturing division of our parent company,[ Kuala
Lumpur Kepong Berhad][35], a leading international plantations group listed on Main Market of Bursa
Malaysia Securities Berhad with a market capitalisation of approximately RM22.94 (USD5.45) billion
at the end of September 2025.

Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as

end-use applications, including beauty & personal care, home care, industries & institutional (I&I)
cleaning, life science, food & nutrition, lubricants, polymers and more.

MSD Global is a leading business player in oleochemicals industry. The core business is down stream
resources of palm oil, dealing in oleochemicals, speciality fats and edible oil.

### Vision and Mission:

[vision-mission]To be a leading player for offering quality oleochemicals and related products by
satisfying our customer needs through continual improvement and sustaining long term growth in
volume and profitability.

★ Our business activities include oleochemicals, speciality fats and edible oil. Our portfolio of
customers is from personal care, soap & detergent, cosmetics & toiletries, pharmaceuticals, food
additives, rubber & latex, paints, inks & coatings, candle & waxes, Grease & lubricants, resins,
animal feed products

★ Through our large volume business integration and logistical advantages of its business model, MSD
global works on very sharp margins and there by providing competitive pricing for benefiting final
customers

### Core Values:

[Vission mission]


#### Customer Centric

To offer oleochemicals and speciality fats quality according to customers’ requirements with the
most effective & efficient resources management. To assure customers’ satisfaction toward our
products (quality) and services (fast & accurate)

[Vission mission]


#### Credibility & Integrity

We value honesty, trustworthiness and high ethical standards. We will continue to serve our
customers better by setting the best standards for our products and people. We believe that mutually
beneficial relationship serve long term partnership with our customers and manufacturers.

[Vission mission]


#### Leader

To be a leading trading company in Palm & palm kernel oils and their derivatives. To keep abreast of
technological developments in the fats & oils production and related fields


[Vission mission]


#### Focused

We are Focused and committed to building Real and long lasting Partnerships with all our
manufacturers and customers, this is critical in achieving sustainability and prolonged success.

[Vission mission]


#### Innovation

We value innovative efforts, ideas and methods to continually improve our business process. Fresh
creative ideas leading to an extended range of products and solutions that add value serve as one
stop solutions and provide a strong competitive edge for the success of our customer and clients.

[Vission mission]


#### Team work

We work as one team to achieve our corporate goal

The Oakland Ballers, a professional baseball club in Oakland, run a ballpark concessions operation
with multiple fryers.

answer was "we'll be there today" followed by another no-show. Four weeks of asking never produced a
container, so oil from a multi-fryer concessions operation kept piling up with nowhere to go.

Myk got fed up and called Oil Guyz on May 28, 2026, with oil piling up and no time to wait. The team
moved that same afternoon: service agreement signed, a large locked collection bin placed on site,
the backlog of oil picked up, and a CDFA-compliant manifest handed over. Because a ballpark schedule
is irregular, we set up an on-call, game-day pickup plan instead of forcing a fixed route cadence.

### The result

Bin placed, oil gone, manifest in hand, schedule solved, and a 5-star Google review posted that same
night.

Bite-sized insights on how the world is changing, published every few days.

* [
  [Stacked area chart of shares of egg production in the United Kingdom by housing system
  (free-range, cages, barns) from 1996 to 2025 where free-range rises from 10% in 1996 to 75% in
  2025, with cages declining and barns remaining a small share. Source: Defra (2023, 2026). License:
  CC BY.]
  
  Today
  
  ### Three-quarters of eggs produced in the United Kingdom are free-range
  
  Hannah Ritchie and Pablo Rosado
  
  Growing up in the United Kingdom in the 1990s and early 2000s, almost all the eggs in our
  supermarket came from battery hens, those raised in small wire enclosures.
  
  The living conditions in these cages are terrible. Birds get the space equivalent of an A4 sheet
  of paper. They don’t have the room to carry out their natural behaviors, such as nesting,
  perching, or dust bathing.
  
  That has changed in recent decades. You can see this in the chart, which shows the conditions
  under which eggs are produced in the UK. Free-range eggs have increased from just 10% to 75%.
  
  The use of caged hens has fallen, and the types of caged enclosures have also changed. Battery
  cages were banned in 2012, so legally, all cages since then have been “enriched” ones, which
  provide slightly more space. Still, these do not give hens the freedom and room they’d have in
  barns or free-range farms. Studies suggest that moving hens from enriched cages to cage-free
  systems reduces the time they spend in pain by more than half.
  
  And given that most eggs in the UK are now free-range, it’s possible to reduce this pain even
  further.
  
  Read my article on what the conditions of hens look like under caged versus cage-free systems
  Continue reading

  [Line chart of annual global population growth rate (percentage) where growth peaked at 2.3% in
  1963, fell to less than 1% by 2020, and UN projections show rates declining toward zero and
  becoming negative by 2100, implying a shrinking global population. Source: UN, World Population
  Prospects (2024). License: CC BY.]
  
  July 23
  
  ### Global population growth peaked six decades ago
  
  Esteban Ortiz-Ospina and Pablo Arriagada
  
  The increase in the world’s population is not exponential. The global population is growing, but
  the growth rate has declined since its peak six decades ago.
  
  The chart shows the annual rate of global population growth according to historical estimates and
  projections from the UN World Population Prospects.
  
  The growth rate peaked in 1963 at over 2% per year, and since then, it has more than halved,
  falling to less than 1% by 2020.
  
  The UN demographers expect rates to continue falling until the end of the century, eventually
  leading to negative growth rates and a shrinking global population.
  
  Explore how these projections change with different assumptions in our new population simulation
  tool
  Continue reading

  [Horizontal bar chart of medical doctors per 1,000 people by country income group, where
  high-income countries have about 3.78 doctors per 1,000 and low-income countries about 0.38,
  showing roughly ten times more doctors in rich than poor countries. Data for 2022 from Global
  Health Workforce Statistics, WHO, via World Bank (2026). License: CC BY.]
  
  July 21
  
  ### Rich countries have ten times as many doctors per person as poor ones
  
  Hannah Ritchie and Pablo Arriagada
  
  A person’s access to doctors depends heavily on the income level of the country they live in.
  
  High-income countries have around ten times as many doctors per person as low-income ones. You can
  see this in the chart, which shows the number of medical doctors per 1,000 people.
  
  The global average is around 1.9 doctors per 1,000. Low-income countries have around one-fifth of
  that figure.
  
  These figures include generalist physicians and specialists.
  
  Explore more data on healthcare spending and access
  Continue reading

  [Horizontal bar chart of the share of children younger than five years who are stunted across
  Central American and Caribbean countries, where Guatemala is highest at 46% and the other
  countries range from 6.7% to 22%. Source: World Health Organization - Global Health Observatory
  (2026). License: CC BY.]
  
  July 18
  
  ### Nearly half of young children in Guatemala suffer from stunting
  
  Esteban Ortiz-Ospina
  
  Chronic malnutrition in early childhood can slow development and growth, leaving children shorter
  than expected for their age. That’s the focus of the chart: the share of children under five who
  are stunted, meaning they are much shorter than expected for healthy growth.
  
  The consequences of stunting persist beyond childhood, affecting both physical health and
  cognitive development.
  
  Guatemala has one of the highest stunting rates in the world: almost half of children younger than
  five are stunted according to survey estimates published by the World Health Organization.
  
  Guatemala’s rate is the highest in its region, by far. In the chart, you can see it compared to a
  selection of other nearby countries – its rate is twice that of Haiti, the next-highest country
  and a much poorer one.
  
  My colleagues Hannah Ritchie and Tuna Acisu recently wrote about what countries with high stunting
  today can learn from Japan. Over the 20th century, Japan reduced childhood stunting from over 70%
  to under 5%, and the decline from around Guatemala's current level to under 5% took place within a
  generation.

  births per woman, down from 1993 values ranging from 1.8 to 3.8 births per woman. Source: Human
  Fertility Database (2025). License: CC BY.]
  
  July 16
  
  ### Fertility rates across many countries have converged, despite starting from very different
  ### levels
  
  Hannah Ritchie

  changed much. In 1993, the fertility rate was 1.8 births per woman. Thirty years later, it had
  dropped only slightly, to 1.6 births.

  now similar to those in the UK.

  2023 (in red). In Qatar and Iran, rates dropped from almost 4 births per woman to 1.7.

  two examples (my colleague Esteban previously wrote about the latter). This marks a much faster
  demographic transition than many countries experienced historically.

  are similar to the UK’s today. But some have fallen far below these levels: in Chile and Thailand,
  the fertility rate was 1.2 births per woman in 2023, and may have fallen even further.

# WELCOME TO PEMAC PROJECTS

Pemac Projects Pvt. Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of Oil Mill, Crushing & Seed Preparation Plants
for soybeans, sunflower, cotton seed, shea nut, canola, sesame, mustard, rape seed, groundnut,
castor, palm fruit, and palm kernel, supported by high-efficiency expellers and screw press systems.
The company also delivers Continuous Solvent Extraction Plants for soybean, rice bran, and various
cakes with high-protein preparation, along with advanced Soybean Crushing Machinery, Shea Butter
Extraction Plants, and multipurpose Vegetable, Cooking & Edible Oil Refinery Plants equipped with
Water/Acid/Enzymatic Degumming, Neutralizing, Bleaching, and Deodorizing units.

Pemac specializes in Fat Modification Technologies including Dry Fractionation Plants for palm oil
and shea butter, Dewaxing/Winterization for sunflower, rice bran, and cotton seed oils, and
Inter-Esterification Vanaspati, Hydrogenation Plants, Bakery Shortening and Margarine Plants, along
with dedicated Lecithin Plants. Its expertise extends to complete Oleochemicals Plants covering Oil
Splitting, Esterification, Transesterification, Fatty Acid Distillation, Fractionation,
Hydrogenation, Molecular Distillation, Fatty Acid Plants, as well as Glycerine Pretreatment,
Evaporation & Refining Plants, Fatty Alcohol Refining, Wax/Methyl Ester Hydrogenation, Soap Stock
Splitting, & Acid Oil Plants.

## OUR CERTIFICATES

## These certificates highlight our focus on quality assurance, compliance, and continuous
## improvement across all operations.

The company also provides advanced Biodiesel Plants with Transesterification, Methyl Ester,
Glycerolysis, Methanol Recovery, Distillation, Fractionation & Hydrogenation, along with Ethanol
Plants (Distilleries), Effluent & Waste Water Treatment Plants (ZLD), Lube/Used/Waste Oil
Purification Plants, Cattle & Poultry Feed Plants, and a wide range of Filtration Equipment such as
Horizontal & Vertical Pressure Leaf Filters, and Micro Polish Filters. Additional technologies
include MCT Extraction from Coconut Oils and Palm Kernel Oils, Wax Mechanical/Solvent Extraction
Plants, Spent Earth Oil Extraction Plants, and Tocotrienol/Tocopherol Extraction systems.

# WELCOME TO PEMAC PROJECTS

Pemac Projects Pvt. Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of Oil Mill, Crushing & Seed Preparation Plants
for soybeans, sunflower, cotton seed, shea nut, canola, sesame, mustard, rape seed, groundnut,
castor, palm fruit, and palm kernel, supported by high-efficiency expellers and screw press systems.
The company also delivers Continuous Solvent Extraction Plants for soybean, rice bran, and various
cakes with high-protein preparation, along with advanced Soybean Crushing Machinery, Shea Butter
Extraction Plants, and multipurpose Vegetable, Cooking & Edible Oil Refinery Plants equipped with
Water/Acid/Enzymatic Degumming, Neutralizing, Bleaching, and Deodorizing units.

Pemac specializes in Fat Modification Technologies including Dry Fractionation Plants for palm oil
and shea butter, Dewaxing/Winterization for sunflower, rice bran, and cotton seed oils, and
Inter-Esterification Vanaspati, Hydrogenation Plants, Bakery Shortening and Margarine Plants, along
with dedicated Lecithin Plants. Its expertise extends to complete Oleochemicals Plants covering Oil
Splitting, Esterification, Transesterification, Fatty Acid Distillation, Fractionation,
Hydrogenation, Molecular Distillation, Fatty Acid Plants, as well as Glycerine Pretreatment,
Evaporation & Refining Plants, Fatty Alcohol Refining, Wax/Methyl Ester Hydrogenation, Soap Stock
Splitting, & Acid Oil Plants.

## OUR CERTIFICATES

## These certificates highlight our focus on quality assurance, compliance, and continuous
## improvement across all operations.

The company also provides advanced Biodiesel Plants with Transesterification, Methyl Ester,
Glycerolysis, Methanol Recovery, Distillation, Fractionation & Hydrogenation, along with Ethanol
Plants (Distilleries), Effluent & Waste Water Treatment Plants (ZLD), Lube/Used/Waste Oil
Purification Plants, Cattle & Poultry Feed Plants, and a wide range of Filtration Equipment such as
Horizontal & Vertical Pressure Leaf Filters, and Micro Polish Filters. Additional technologies
include MCT Extraction from Coconut Oils and Palm Kernel Oils, Wax Mechanical/Solvent Extraction
Plants, Spent Earth Oil Extraction Plants, and Tocotrienol/Tocopherol Extraction systems.

# P&G Chemicals develops bio-based materials that can be used in a wide range of applications.
* Our products are created from responsibly sourced natural feedstocks. [Learn more here][9].
* Our portfolio of fatty alcohols, fatty acids, methyl esters and glycerin offers you a choice of
  low carbon options, including carbon negative and near carbon neutral versions. [Learn more
  here][10].
* Suitable for use in a wide range of applications including: agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals,
  personal care, fabric & home care products and lubricants.

## New carbon footprint solutions

**P&G Chemicals offer a range of carbon footprint solutions to help meet your business needs and
those of your customers.**

Through a combination of sourcing and manufacturing expertise we are able to provide a range of
options.
Our Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) are calculated from cradle to gate and include biogenic uptake.

Regular

Our mainline offering provides a **lower carbon** footprint than industry average carbon footprint*.

[Learn More][11]

Low

Our premium offering has a **significantly lower carbon** footprint than industry average*, helping
you make progress on your decarbonization journey.

[Learn More][12]

Ultra Low

Our flagship offering is **carbon negative**, an ideal choice to help you develop carbon neutral
formulations.

[Learn More][13]

* based on ERASM 2017 SLE Project PKO data + PGC scope 1, 2 and 3. To learn more, please contact us
[here][14].

The methodology used to calculate the Carbon Footprint through our supply chain is based on the ISO
14067 standard and follows the **Together for Sustainability** guideline. It has been certified in
2024 by **TUV Rheinland**, an independent organization of experts. The Product Carbon Footprints
(PCF) offered under our 3 different solutions have been verified in 2024 by TÜV Rheinland.

## Our product range

## Fatty Alcohols

We offer mid and heavy cut fatty alcohols. Our manufacturing operations in Europe, Asia, and
Americas provide responsiveness and supply assurance across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][15]

## Fatty Acids

We offer a range of high purity short chain fatty acids, suitable for a wide range of applications
including MCTs (Medium-Chain Triglycerides), lubricants and agricultural chemical formulations.

[LEARN MORE][16]

## Glycerin

For over 160 years, we have produced high quality glycerin. Today our range includes USP and FCC
grade with GMP Certificate for Food (BRC, FSSC).

[LEARN MORE][17]

## Methyl Esters

Our portfolio of methyl esters includes a variety of broad and high purity cuts that can be supplied
across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][18]

## Get to know us

P&G Chemicals has been making products using naturally derived chemistry for over 160 years. We were
first established to deliver the high-quality ingredients and supply chains that Procter & Gamble
(our parent company) needed to develop our superior branded consumer products. Today our horizons
have broadened – so we serve not only P&G but leading chemical companies, in over 40 countries
across the globe, as a trusted supplier of naturally derived bio-solutions. 

[LEARN MORE][19]

## Sustainability

Our passion is to act as a catalyst for sustainable business growth – through responsibly sourced,
natural based low carbon products. With a global technical, manufacturing and supply chain network
based in North America, Europe and Asia, we think globally and act locally delivering quality,
reliablity and supply chain resilience.

Our products are designed with our impact, your impact and your customers needs in mind. We do this
by responsibly sourcing natural materials, creating products that enable our customers to reduce
their footprint and by driving positive impacts through partnerships and programs.

[LEARN MORE][20]

and solar solutions, all of which you can browse directly on our website. We are immensely proud of
our strong industry partnerships and representing Sigenergy! One of our directors, Scott, recently
caught up with our friends at Failte Solar (one of Sigenergy's premier platinum partners), while
Charlie and Nik from our Sales team were proud to wear our new Sig hats out at Moor Park. These
relationships ensure we bring our installers reliable stock, competitive pricing, and top-tier
support. 🧢⛳ Head over to our website to check out the range, or reach out to our team to get a
quote for your next project! 📩 Plus, scan the QR code to download the mySigen app - the ultimate
tool for streamlined system setup for installers, and real-time AI energy monitoring for your
customers! 📱✨ 📞 Heathrow: 01753 983978 📞 Brackley: 01604 340018 ✉️ admin@rapidrenewables.co.uk
@sigenergy_official @sigenergy.global #SolarPV #EnergyStorage #Sigenergy #RapidRenewables
#TradeSupplier #RenewableEnergy] ][155]
[ Investing in skills, training, and partnerships fo [Investing in skills, training, and
partnerships for a sustainable future 🚀 It’s been a busy, rewarding period at Rapid Renewables as
we expand our industry knowledge and strengthen our partnerships! Here’s a quick wrap-up of what
we’ve been up to: 🛠️ K2 Systems Training: Our buyer, Nimpreet, and Marketing Manager, Nicki, dove
into K2’s mounting solutions, roof types, and their DocuApp. This firsthand product insight directly
improves our buying strategies and online product support. 🎓 EEA Skills and Training Conference:
Nimpreet and Nicki also headed to the Institute of Directors in London to discuss addressing green
sector skills shortages alongside industry leaders like MCS and GSAP. 📐 Van der Valk Training:
Chris Campbell from Van der Valk Solar Systems walked our team through their latest mounting
solutions, intuitive new design system, and upcoming product rollouts. ⛳ Rapid Golf Day: All of
this training comes right on the back of our fantastic day out at Moor Park Golf Club! It was
brilliant catching up with so many of our amazing partners, customers, and co-sponsors on the green.
Investing in our team ensures we remain your trusted partner in the renewable energy sector! 🌍
#Renewables #GreenSkills #SolarEnergy #Networking #Events] ][156]

☀️🏌️‍♂️ It was an absolute treat to tee off in such a stunning setting. A massive thank you to everyone
at Moor Park for their outstanding hospitality and making sure everything ran so smoothly! 🏰✨
Thank you to all of our incredible partners, customers, and friends who joined us. To our
co-sponsors: Van Der Valk, DMEGC, and Failte Solar/Sigenergy: thank you for championing this event
alongside us. Your partnership is invaluable, and we're proud to work with such fantastic teams!
Despite the heat, everyone brought amazing energy and great competitive spirit. A massive shoutout
to Mark Holman and the team at Rapid Electrical Distributors for organizing such a fantastic day. We
were absolutely delighted to partner up with you! 🙌 We were also proud to support Rennie Grove
Peace Hospice Care and thank Jackie Jackson for sharing such an inspiring look into the vital work
they do. It was an incredible day of company, networking, and fundraising. We hope you all had a
brilliant time, and we can't wait to see you back out there in 2027! 🥂⛳ #GolfDay2026 #CharityGolf
